This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] enlisted member of the crew aboard the ''[[Concussor]]'', an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]].<ref name="MK" /> During one of the ''Concussor''{{'s}} patrols in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the vessel picked up an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] containing [[Bhindi Drayson]] and her unit of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit that planned to take over the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="MK" />

When the Wraiths began their operation, [[Jesmin Tainer]] and [[Trey Courser]] were tasked with making their way to the auxiliary bridge and capturing it. On their way, they encountered the female crew member at an intersection. Tainer prepared to strike and quietly subdue the woman, but the latter's mind was clearly on something else, and she did not notice the two Wraiths waiting around the corner as she continued on her way.<ref name="MK" />

After the Wraiths succeeded in capturing the ''Concussor'', the entire crew was dropped off on a habitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of a distant [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with substantial provisions to live off.<ref name="MK" />
